name: print-social-yellow-hexagon-business-idea-post-with-charcoal-panel
title: 'Are You Looking for Finest Idea?' post with a charcoal hexagon panel and yellow-framed photo
whatItIs: A square post with a charcoal pointed panel holding white and yellow uppercase text, overlapping a photo of a smiling man with earphones at a laptop framed by a yellow hexagonal outline, with a pale grey base and a phone contact.
whatItMeans: Structured and professional; hexagonal edges feel techy and forward-pointing.
techniques: Point a text panel into the photo like an arrow.
Frame the photo with a thick yellow angular stroke.
Break the headline into white and yellow lines.

vocabulary.definition: A text block with an arrow-like edge.
A stroke with cut corners around an image.
